answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in escrow before it can earn, released only after a long season of honest work verified by peers. A newcomer starts at the nadir of trust and must build a public record of useful, attested transactions, like a lagoon that only deepens slowly, before touching larger rewards. Spinning up a hundred fake identities means locking a hundred stakes and paying a hundred deposits, while an ivory-tower shortcut such as buying old accounts fails because each stake is bound to the agent's own key and cannot be transferred.
